name: Axiom Cares (The Funeral Version)
creator: Originally: Axiom Workforce Solutions Content Group; remixed by anonymous Shelf feed operators
description: A 2209 Axiom internal memorial feed for workers killed in the Ward Nine substrate trials was accidentally broadcast on public neural channels, complete with upbeat brand music and a 'Φ0 deductible for qualifying dependents' footer overlay. Within six hours, the clip had been remixed with funeral drums, gospel harmonics, and increasingly elaborate text additions. The phrase 'Axiom Cares — Terms and Conditions Apply' became the default ironic epitaph for any corporate betrayal.
medium: neural feed clip, remixed audio-visual loops
cultural_impact: Became the defining shorthand for corponation indifference dressed as compassion; 'Axiom Cares' is now spoken at funerals on the Shelf without irony, having completed the full cycle from joke to genuine mourning ritual.
controversy: Axiom issued seventeen separate legal takedowns; each takedown notification was itself remixed into the meme, adding layers. The original unedited clip is considered legally hazardous to redistribute.
story_hooks: A character discovers the original unedited broadcast still cached in a decommissioned BCI relay node — and someone very corporate wants it deleted permanently.
The phrase 'Axiom Cares' is spoken sincerely by a Tier 4 character who has no idea of its history, creating a moment of devastating class-gap miscommunication.
A Shelf grief counselor has begun using the remixed funeral version in actual memorial services — Axiom's legal team is trying to shut them down.
